title: Cosmic Skull Rider
description: A multi-armed skeletal figure glowing with purple energy rides a flaming motorcycle through a surreal night sky. Behind it looms a massive cracked eyeball planet surrounded by screaming skulls, while a dark city and mountains sit below under swirling blue and purple nebulae.
prompt: A glowing multi-armed skeletal entity with multiple screaming skull faces rides a flaming motorcycle across a surreal cosmic landscape. The figure has purple energy lines and a star emblem on its chest, leaving trails of fire and colorful smoke. In the background is a giant cracked blue eyeball planet with screaming skulls orbiting it, set against a starry night sky with vibrant blue and purple nebulae. Below are dark mountains, a bare tree with purple lights, and a glowing cyberpunk city skyline.
